caption: The drawing contains two objects. On the left side, there is a depiction of a small, square-shaped building resembling a bank with the words "HALL S EXCELSIOR BANK" written across the front in blue, capital letters. The building is mainly beige with red trim on the front corners and around the roof, and it has a wide blue base and blue roof. The roof is flat with a central raised portion topped by a red cupola. The front façade features a central door with arched windows on either side, all accented by diamond lattice designs, and a small set of red steps leads up to the entrance. On the right side of the drawing, there is a depiction of the building’s roof removed, revealing a mechanical figure on a platform. This figure has a rounded blue and beige hat or cap and sits next to a sign that reads "MASTER." The platform and base are colored in blue and beige, and a red accent is visible at the rear of the structure. The drawing is made on an off-white background, and all elements are rendered in a detailed illustrative style using primarily blue, red, beige, and a little brown color.
title: Iron Bank
